text:
**It is not possible to tell whether clearing is still happening today.** The evidence identifies about 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2021, but does not report whether further loss occurred after that year. Although the dataset extends through 2025, it does not establish conditions today.

Most of the 2021 loss area was mapped as planted pine forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish permanent deforestation or the cause of the loss.
